From: Samantha Lopez <samantha.lopez@northstarbiomed.com>

Cc: evan.procure@northstarbiomed.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II copy + supplemental artifacts and bridge letter

Hi Marissa / Ben,

Thanks for the time yesterday. Northstar is running a security gate for our vendor inventory next week and we need to collect a couple of items to complete the review. Can you please provide: 1) a copy of Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report for the most recent period, 2) a bridge letter if the report period doesn't overlap our audit window (June 1 - May 31), and 3) supplemental artifacts tied to authn/authz controls—specifically: MFA configuration summary, a sample of privileged account deprovisioning records for the past 90 days, and a short slice of auth logs around login events (redacted where necessary).

We realize some of those items are sensitive; if you prefer we can accept scoped samples and an attestation describing what was withheld. Also confirm your earliest ETA to deliver the matrix so our procurement team can align DocuSign/PO timing.

Appreciate it — Samantha
Samantha Lopez
Sr. InfoSec Manager, Northstar Biomed
S: (415) 555-0182

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 Type II copy + supplemental artifacts and bridge letter

Samantha —

Thanks for the clear ask and the template. We can provide the SOC 2 Type II (most recent period) and a bridge letter if the period doesn't cover your audit window. For the supplemental items you listed, we typically deliver scoped artifacts and a short evidentiary narrative to avoid exposing PII. Proposed approach:

- SOC 2 Type II (PDF): full report with redactions limited to customer names in test descriptions.
- Bridge letter: confirms controls and any relevant period gaps.
- MFA configuration summary: high-level config export (factors enabled, enforcement policy, enrollment rates) + confirmation of our enforced MFA for all console/admin users.
- Privileged deprovisioning: CSV stub of deprovision events (user id, role removed, date) for the requested 90-day window with user identifiers hashed.
- Auth log slice: 7-day tarball containing login events (timestamp, event_type, subject_hash, source_ip_range) — we will remove any token/session values.

I'll attach the SOC 2 and a draft evidence matrix that maps each Northstar item to what we can provide and the expected delivery date. Can you confirm your acceptance of hashed identifiers in deprovisioning records and IP-range instead of exact IPs in log slices? Also, please confirm the audit window you're validating against once more (you mentioned June 1 - May 31).

ETA: If we have alignment on scope today, I can commit to delivering the matrix + SOC 2 PDF by Monday EOD and the scoped artifacts by next Thursday (7 calendar days after acceptance). If you need faster, we can escalate.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Trust & Security, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood_soc2_type2_2026.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: evidence-request-matrix-northstar.xlsx (xlsx)]

Marissa —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the matrix. Confirming the audit window we are validating against is: June 1, 2026 — May 31, 2027. Hashed identifiers and IP ranges are acceptable. Procurement just needs the non-disclosure addendum signed; I sent an initial DocuSign earlier this morning (link below).

Two follow-ups from InfoSec: 1) for MFA summary please include enforcement date for policy changes (if any) and the list of primary vs fallback factors; 2) for the auth log slice, can you include an index file (CSV) describing the contents of the tarball so we can verify completeness without unpacking raw logs.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.net/contract/NDAXYZ-4567

If you can get the SOC 2 + bridge letter and the matrix by EOD Monday, we'll mark the ticket high priority and proceed with procurement review.

Cheers,
Samantha
